mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal housing sector contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (industrial production growth <0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in >60% of instances when GDPC1 is positive, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor markets (unemployment rate <3.5%), a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances when PAYEMS declines in tight labor markets, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI (CPIAUCSL) signal aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
